name: syb-widgets
description: SurfYogaBeer website widgets (Google reviews, WhatsApp button, Instagram grid). Replaces Elfsight.

scripts.build: python3 scripts/build-reviews.py && cp src/*.js dist/ && for f in syb-reviews syb-whatsapp syb-instagram; do npx -y terser@5 dist/$f.js -c -m -o dist/$f.min.js; done
